<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Build script for Yggdrasil JSX Transpiler (Windows / PowerShell).

.DESCRIPTION
    Wraps clang++ invocations for developers who prefer PowerShell over make.
    Supports Debug, Release, and Test modes.

.PARAMETER Mode
    Build mode: Debug | Release | Clean | Test (default: Debug)

.PARAMETER Run
    After a successful build, run the transpiler with these arguments.
    Example: .\build.ps1 -Run "tests\fixtures\basic.jsx"

.EXAMPLE
    .\build.ps1
    .\build.ps1 -Mode Release
    .\build.ps1 -Mode Test
    .\build.ps1 -Mode Debug -Run "tests\fixtures\basic.jsx"
#>

param(
    [ValidateSet("Debug","Release","Clean","Test")]
    [string]$Mode = "Debug",

    [string]$Run = ""
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Paths
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$Root      = $PSScriptRoot
$SrcDir    = Join-Path $Root "src"
$IncDir    = Join-Path $Root "include"
$BuildDir  = Join-Path $Root "build"
$BinDir    = Join-Path $Root "bin"
$Target    = Join-Path $BinDir "yggdrasil.exe"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Compiler settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$CXX       = "clang++"
$BaseFlags = @("-std=c++17", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Wpedantic", "-I$IncDir")

$ModeFlags = switch ($Mode) {
    "Debug"   { @("-g", "-O0", "-DDEBUG", "-fsanitize=address,undefined") }
    "Release" { @("-O2", "-DNDEBUG") }
    default   { @() }
}

$CXXFlags = $BaseFlags + $ModeFlags

$LDFlags = if ($Mode -eq "Debug") {
    @("-fsanitize=address,undefined")
} else {
    @()
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Invoke-Checked {
    param([string]$Exe, [string[]]$Args)
    Write-Host "> $Exe $($Args -join ' ')" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    & $Exe @Args
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Write-Error "Command failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE"
    }
}

function Get-Sources {
    Get-ChildItem -Path $SrcDir -Filter "*.cpp" | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Clean
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($Mode -eq "Clean") {
    Write-Host "Cleaning build artefacts..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    if (Test-Path $BuildDir) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $BuildDir }
    if (Test-Path $BinDir)   { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $BinDir   }
    Write-Host "Done." -ForegroundColor Green
    exit 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test (run fixture tests without rebuilding if binary exists)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($Mode -eq "Test") {
    if (-not (Test-Path $Target)) {
        Write-Host "Binary not found - building first (Debug)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        & $PSCommandPath -Mode Debug
    }
    Write-Host "=== Running fixture tests ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    $pass = 0; $fail = 0
    $fixtures = Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $Root "tests\fixtures") -Filter "*.jsx" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    foreach ($jsx in $fixtures) {
        $expectedPath = [IO.Path]::ChangeExtension($jsx.FullName, ".expected.js")
        if (-not (Test-Path $expectedPath)) { continue }
        $actual   = & $Target $jsx.FullName 2>&1 | Out-String
        $expected = Get-Content $expectedPath -Raw
        if ($actual.TrimEnd() -eq $expected.TrimEnd()) {
            Write-Host "  PASS: $($jsx.Name)" -ForegroundColor Green
            $pass++
        } else {
            Write-Host "  FAIL: $($jsx.Name)" -ForegroundColor Red
            Write-Host "  -- expected --" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow
            Write-Host $expected
            Write-Host "  -- actual --" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow
            Write-Host $actual
            $fail++
        }
    }
    Write-Host "Results: $pass passed, $fail failed" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    if ($fail -gt 0) { exit 1 } else { exit 0 }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $BuildDir | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $BinDir   | Out-Null

$sources = Get-Sources
$objects = @()

Write-Host "=== Compiling ($Mode) ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan

foreach ($src in $sources) {
    $name = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($src)
    $obj  = Join-Path $BuildDir "$name.o"
    $objects += $obj
    Invoke-Checked $CXX ($CXXFlags + @("-c", "-o", $obj, $src))
}

Write-Host "=== Linking ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Invoke-Checked $CXX ($CXXFlags + $LDFlags + @("-o", $Target) + $objects)

Write-Host "Built: $Target" -ForegroundColor Green

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Optional: run after build
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($Run -ne "") {
    Write-Host "=== Running ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Invoke-Checked $Target @($Run)
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Build script for Yggdrasil JSX Transpiler (Windows / PowerShell).

.DESCRIPTION
    Stage 4: builds libyggdrasil.lib (static library) then yggdrasil.exe
    (thin CLI wrapper).  GlacioJS can link against libyggdrasil.lib and
    include yggdrasil.h without touching the CLI.

.PARAMETER Mode
    Build mode: Debug | Release | Clean | Test (default: Debug)

.PARAMETER Run
    After a successful build, run the transpiler with these arguments.

.EXAMPLE
    .\build.ps1
    .\build.ps1 -Mode Release
    .\build.ps1 -Mode Test
    .\build.ps1 -Mode Debug -Run "tests\fixtures\basic.jsx"
#>

param(
    [ValidateSet("Debug","Release","Clean","Test")]
    [string]$Mode = "Debug",

    [string]$Run = ""
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Paths
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$Root     = $PSScriptRoot
$SrcDir   = Join-Path $Root "src"
$IncDir   = Join-Path $Root "include"
$BuildDir = Join-Path $Root "build"
$BinDir   = Join-Path $Root "bin"
$LibDir   = Join-Path $Root "lib"

$CliTarget = Join-Path $BinDir "yggdrasil.exe"
$LibTarget = Join-Path $LibDir "libyggdrasil.lib"   # MSVC-style name (llvm-lib)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Compiler / archiver
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$CXX = "clang++"
$AR  = "llvm-lib"     # clang's static archiver on Windows; falls back to lib.exe

$BaseFlags = @("-std=c++17", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Wpedantic", "-I$IncDir")

$ModeFlags = switch ($Mode) {
    "Debug"   { @("-g", "-O0", "-DDEBUG", "-fsanitize=address,undefined") }
    "Release" { @("-O2", "-DNDEBUG") }
    default   { @() }
}

$CXXFlags = $BaseFlags + $ModeFlags

$LDFlags = if ($Mode -eq "Debug") {
    @("-fsanitize=address,undefined")
} else {
    @()
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Invoke-Checked {
    param([string]$Exe, [string[]]$Args)
    Write-Host "> $Exe $($Args -join ' ')" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    & $Exe @Args
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Write-Error "Command failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE"
    }
}

# Sources that belong to libyggdrasil (everything except main.cpp)
function Get-LibSources {
    Get-ChildItem -Path $SrcDir -Filter "*.cpp" |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -ne "main.cpp" } |
        Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Clean
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($Mode -eq "Clean") {
    Write-Host "Cleaning build artefacts..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    foreach ($d in @($BuildDir, $BinDir, $LibDir)) {
        if (Test-Path $d) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $d }
    }
    Write-Host "Done." -ForegroundColor Green
    exit 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($Mode -eq "Test") {
    if (-not (Test-Path $CliTarget)) {
        Write-Host "Binary not found - building first (Debug)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        & $PSCommandPath -Mode Debug
    }
    Write-Host "=== Running fixture tests ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    & (Join-Path $Root "tests\runner\run_tests.ps1") -Binary $CliTarget
    exit $LASTEXITCODE
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
foreach ($d in @($BuildDir, $BinDir, $LibDir)) {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $d | Out-Null
}

# --- Step 1: compile library sources → .o files ---
$libSources = Get-LibSources
$libObjects = @()

Write-Host "=== Compiling libyggdrasil ($Mode) ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan

foreach ($src in $libSources) {
    $name = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($src)
    $obj  = Join-Path $BuildDir "$name.o"
    $libObjects += $obj
    Invoke-Checked $CXX ($CXXFlags + @("-c", "-o", $obj, $src))
}

# --- Step 2: archive into static library ---
Write-Host "=== Archiving $LibTarget ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan

# Try llvm-lib first; fall back to lib.exe (MSVC)
$arOk = $false
if (Get-Command $AR -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
    Invoke-Checked $AR (@("/OUT:$LibTarget") + $libObjects)
    $arOk = $true
} elseif (Get-Command "lib.exe" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
    Invoke-Checked "lib.exe" (@("/OUT:$LibTarget") + $libObjects)
    $arOk = $true
}

if (-not $arOk) {
    # Neither archiver found; fall back to a thin link so the build still works
    Write-Warning "llvm-lib / lib.exe not found; creating thin .lib via clang++"
    Invoke-Checked $CXX ($CXXFlags + @("-r", "-o", $LibTarget) + $libObjects)
}

Write-Host "Static library: $LibTarget" -ForegroundColor Green

# --- Step 3: compile main.cpp → main.o ---
Write-Host "=== Compiling CLI wrapper ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
$mainSrc = Join-Path $SrcDir "main.cpp"
$mainObj = Join-Path $BuildDir "main.o"
Invoke-Checked $CXX ($CXXFlags + @("-c", "-o", $mainObj, $mainSrc))

# --- Step 4: link CLI binary ---
Write-Host "=== Linking $CliTarget ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Invoke-Checked $CXX ($CXXFlags + $LDFlags + @("-o", $CliTarget, $mainObj, $LibTarget))

Write-Host "CLI binary: $CliTarget" -ForegroundColor Green

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Optional: run after build
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($Run -ne "") {
    Write-Host "=== Running ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Invoke-Checked $CliTarget @($Run)
}

# =============================================================================
# Yggdrasil — JSX Transpiler
# Compiler: clang++ (C++17)
# Cross-platform: Windows (cmd/nmake-style) and Unix (bash)
# =============================================================================

CXX      := clang++
CXXFLAGS := -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Iinclude
LDFLAGS  :=

# Stage 3: thread pool requires pthreads on non-Windows
ifeq ($(OS),Windows_NT)
    # Windows: threads via Win32 API, no extra lib needed
else
    LDFLAGS += -lpthread
endif

# Directories
SRC_DIR   := src
INC_DIR   := include
BUILD_DIR := build
BIN_DIR   := bin

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# OS detection
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ifeq ($(OS),Windows_NT)
    PLATFORM      := windows
    TARGET        := $(BIN_DIR)/yggdrasil.exe
    RM_RF         := rmdir /s /q
    MKDIR         = if not exist "$@" mkdir "$@"
    DEVNULL       := nul
    # PowerShell available everywhere on modern Windows
    TEST_CMD      := powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass \
                     -File tests\runner\run_tests.ps1 -Binary $(TARGET)
    PATHSEP       := \\
else
    UNAME := $(shell uname -s)
    PLATFORM      := unix
    TARGET        := $(BIN_DIR)/yggdrasil
    RM_RF         := rm -rf
    MKDIR         = mkdir -p "$@"
    DEVNULL       := /dev/null
    TEST_CMD       = @pass=0; fail=0; \
        for jsx in tests/fixtures/*.jsx; do \
            base=$${jsx%.jsx}; \
            expected=$${base}.expected.js; \
            [ -f "$$expected" ] || continue; \
            actual=$$($(TARGET) "$$jsx" 2>&1); \
            exp=$$(cat "$$expected"); \
            if [ "$$actual" = "$$exp" ]; then \
                printf '  \033[32mPASS\033[0m %s\n' "$$jsx"; pass=$$((pass+1)); \
            else \
                printf '  \033[31mFAIL\033[0m %s\n' "$$jsx"; \
                printf '  --- expected ---\n'; echo "$$exp"; \
                printf '  --- actual   ---\n'; echo "$$actual"; \
                fail=$$((fail+1)); \
            fi; \
        done; \
        printf 'Results: %d passed, %d failed\n' "$$pass" "$$fail"; \
        [ $$fail -eq 0 ]
    PATHSEP       := /
endif

# Collect all .cpp sources
SRCS := $(wildcard $(SRC_DIR)/*.cpp)
OBJS := $(patsubst $(SRC_DIR)/%.cpp,$(BUILD_DIR)/%.o,$(SRCS))

# Header dependencies (all headers in include/)
HEADERS := $(wildcard $(INC_DIR)/*.h)

# =============================================================================
# Targets
# =============================================================================

.PHONY: all clean release debug test help

all: $(TARGET)

# Link
$(TARGET): $(OBJS) | $(BIN_DIR)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) $(LDFLAGS) -o $@ $^
	@echo "Built: $@"

# Compile each .cpp -> .o
$(BUILD_DIR)/%.o: $(SRC_DIR)/%.cpp $(HEADERS) | $(BUILD_DIR)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -c -o $@ $<

# Create output directories
$(BUILD_DIR):
	$(MKDIR)

$(BIN_DIR):
	$(MKDIR)

# Debug build (no optimisation, debug symbols, sanitisers)
debug: CXXFLAGS += -g -O0 -DDEBUG -fsanitize=address,undefined
debug: LDFLAGS  += -fsanitize=address,undefined
debug: $(TARGET)

# Release build (optimised)
release: CXXFLAGS += -O2 -DNDEBUG
release: $(TARGET)

# Run test fixtures
test: $(TARGET)
	$(TEST_CMD)

# Clean build artefacts
clean:
ifeq ($(PLATFORM),windows)
	-$(RM_RF) $(BUILD_DIR) 2>$(DEVNULL)
	-$(RM_RF) $(BIN_DIR)   2>$(DEVNULL)
else
	$(RM_RF) $(BUILD_DIR) $(BIN_DIR)
endif

	@echo "Targets:"
	@echo "  all      Build the transpiler (default)"
	@echo "  debug    Build with debug symbols and sanitisers"

# Targets
# =============================================================================

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

debug: LDFLAGS  += -fsanitize=address,undefined

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

	install -d $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/lib
	install -d $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/include
	install -d $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/bin
	install -m 644 $(STATIC_LIB)         $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/lib/
	install -m 644 $(INC_DIR)/yggdrasil.h $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/include/
	install -m 755 $(CLI_TARGET)          $(DESTDIR)$(PREFIX)/bin/

README.md

1	# Yggdrasil
2	
3	A JSX-to-JavaScript transpiler written in C++17.  
4	Yggdrasil parses JSX source files and emits standard JavaScript — the same transformation Babel performs with `@babel/plugin-transform-react-jsx`.
5	
6	It operates in three modes:
7	- **Single-file** — transpile one `.jsx` to stdout or a file
8	- **Batch** — transpile an entire source directory tree in parallel
9	- **Watch** — monitor the source tree and re-transpile on every save
10	
11	---
12	
13	## Features
14	
15	### Stage 1 — Core JSX transpilation
16	- Self-closing, opening/closing, and nested JSX elements
17	- Component tags (uppercase), member-expression tags (`Foo.Bar`)
18	- String, expression, boolean, and spread (`{...obj}`) attributes
19	- JSX fragments (`<>...</>`)
20	- Text children, expression children (`{expr}`), and mapped children
21	- Full JavaScript: `const`/`let`/`var`, arrow functions, destructuring params, `async`/`await`, template literals, spread, ternary, logical operators, `import`/`export` (default, named, namespace, side-effect)
22	- Diagnostic output with `file:line:col` format
23	
24	### Stage 2 — Solid Tool extensions
25	- **Configurable JSX pragma** via `--pragma`: `react` (default), `h`, `jsx`, `auto`
26	- **React 17 auto-import** (`--pragma auto` / `--jsx-runtime automatic`): prepends `import { jsx as _jsx, ... } from 'react/jsx-runtime'`
27	- **Dev mode** (`--dev`): injects `__source` and `__self` props
28	- **Namespace tags**: `<svg:circle />` → `"svg:circle"`
29	- **JSX comments**: `{/* ... */}` silently dropped
30	- **Spread children**: `{...items}` in JSX children
31	- **Hyphenated attributes**: `data-*`, `aria-*` → quoted keys (`"data-x": val`)
32	- **Multi-error recovery** (`--recover`): collects up to 20 errors, reports all
33	- **Per-fixture CLI flags**: `.flags` files for the test runner
34	
35	### Stage 3 — Directory CLI & Batch Transpiler
36	- **Recursive directory scan** — mirrors `src/` tree into `dist/` with `std::filesystem`
37	- **Parallel transpilation** — custom thread pool (`std::thread` + mutex/condition_variable), defaults to `hardware_concurrency` threads
38	- **Passthrough copy** — plain `.js` files copied untouched; skipped with `--no-copy`
39	- **Watch mode** — re-transpiles changed files on save:
40	  - Windows: `ReadDirectoryChangesW` (low-latency, native)
41	  - Other platforms: configurable polling loop (default 500 ms)
42	- **Error isolation** — one bad file never kills the batch; errors aggregated and reported at the end
43	- **`--jsx-pragma` / `--jsx-runtime` aliases** for toolchain compatibility
44	- **`--verbose`** — prints `src/Foo.jsx  ->  dist/Foo.js` for every file
45	- **`--threads N`** — explicit worker count
46

53	- `make` (GNU Make)

81	  yggdrasil [options] --out-dir <dir> <files...>    explicit batch

85	  -o <file>                  Output file (single-file mode)
86	  --out-dir <dir>            Output directory
87	  --pragma <name>            JSX pragma: react (default), h, jsx, auto
88	  --jsx-pragma <name>        Alias for --pragma
89	  --jsx-runtime <mode>       classic (default) | automatic

189	  codegen.cpp    AST walker; lowers JSX to configurable pragma calls
190	  diagnostics.cpp  ErrorCollector::dump()

206	### Key design decisions
207	
208	**Self-managing lexer mode stack** — the lexer tracks JSX context internally (`JSXTag` / `JSXChildren` / `JS`), pushed/popped as it emits specific tokens. The parser never needs to call `pushMode`/`popMode`.
209	
210	**Flat AST node** — all node kinds share one `Node` struct. Avoids virtual dispatch and header pollution.
211	
212	**Parallel batch with error isolation** — each file runs in its own thread-pool task. A `std::mutex` guards the shared `BatchResult`. One failing file increments `failed` but other tasks continue uninterrupted.
213	
214	**Watch mode strategy** — on Windows, `ReadDirectoryChangesW` with `FILE_FLAG_OVERLAPPED` gives sub-second latency with zero CPU spin. On other platforms, a polling loop with configurable interval is used. The watcher calls `BatchEngine::processFile()` directly — same code path as batch.
215

# Yggdrasil

A JSX-to-JavaScript transpiler written in C++17.  
Yggdrasil parses JSX source files and emits standard JavaScript — the same transformation Babel performs with `@babel/plugin-transform-react-jsx`.

It operates in three modes:
- **Single-file** — transpile one `.jsx` to stdout or a file
- **Batch** — transpile an entire source directory tree in parallel
- **Watch** — monitor the source tree and re-transpile on every save

---

## Features

### Stage 1 — Core JSX transpilation
- Self-closing, opening/closing, and nested JSX elements
- Component tags (uppercase), member-expression tags (`Foo.Bar`)
- String, expression, boolean, and spread (`{...obj}`) attributes
- JSX fragments (`<>...</>`)
- Text children, expression children (`{expr}`), and mapped children
- Full JavaScript: `const`/`let`/`var`, arrow functions, destructuring params, `async`/`await`, template literals, spread, ternary, logical operators, `import`/`export` (default, named, namespace, side-effect)
- Diagnostic output with `file:line:col` format

### Stage 2 — Solid Tool extensions
- **Configurable JSX pragma** via `--pragma`: `react` (default), `h`, `jsx`, `auto`
- **React 17 auto-import** (`--pragma auto` / `--jsx-runtime automatic`): prepends `import { jsx as _jsx, ... } from 'react/jsx-runtime'`
- **Dev mode** (`--dev`): injects `__source` and `__self` props
- **Namespace tags**: `<svg:circle />` → `"svg:circle"`
- **JSX comments**: `{/* ... */}` silently dropped
- **Spread children**: `{...items}` in JSX children
- **Hyphenated attributes**: `data-*`, `aria-*` → quoted keys (`"data-x": val`)
- **Multi-error recovery** (`--recover`): collects up to 20 errors, reports all
- **Per-fixture CLI flags**: `.flags` files for the test runner

### Stage 3 — Directory CLI & Batch Transpiler
- **Recursive directory scan** — mirrors `src/` tree into `dist/` with `std::filesystem`
- **Parallel transpilation** — custom thread pool (`std::thread` + mutex/condition_variable), defaults to `hardware_concurrency` threads
- **Passthrough copy** — plain `.js` files copied untouched; skipped with `--no-copy`
- **Watch mode** — re-transpiles changed files on save:
  - Windows: `ReadDirectoryChangesW` (low-latency, native)
  - Other platforms: configurable polling loop (default 500 ms)
- **Error isolation** — one bad file never kills the batch; errors aggregated and reported at the end
- **`--jsx-pragma` / `--jsx-runtime` aliases** for toolchain compatibility
- **`--verbose`** — prints `src/Foo.jsx  ->  dist/Foo.js` for every file
- **`--threads N`** — explicit worker count

---

## Building

### Requirements
- `clang++` with C++17 support
- `make` (GNU Make)
- PowerShell 5.1+ (Windows) or bash (Unix/macOS)

### Build

```sh
# Default
make

# Optimised release
make release

# Debug with ASan/UBSan
make debug

# Clean
make clean
```

Binary: `bin/yggdrasil` (Unix) or `bin\yggdrasil.exe` (Windows).

---

## Usage

```
Usage:
  yggdrasil [options] <input.jsx>                   single file
  yggdrasil [options] --out-dir <dir> <files...>    explicit batch
  yggdrasil [options] <srcDir> --out-dir <dir>      directory batch

Options:
  -o <file>                  Output file (single-file mode)
  --out-dir <dir>            Output directory
  --pragma <name>            JSX pragma: react (default), h, jsx, auto
  --jsx-pragma <name>        Alias for --pragma
  --jsx-runtime <mode>       classic (default) | automatic
  --dev                      Emit __source/__self dev props
  --no-copy                  Skip .js passthrough in batch mode
  --verbose                  Print each file processed
  --watch                    Re-transpile on file changes
  --threads <n>              Worker thread count
  --recover                  Collect multiple errors before stopping
  -h, --help                 Show this help
```

### Examples

```sh
# Single file to stdout
yggdrasil App.jsx

# Single file to output
yggdrasil App.jsx -o App.js

# Directory batch
yggdrasil src/ --out-dir dist/

# Directory batch — Preact pragma, skip .js copy, verbose
yggdrasil src/ --out-dir dist/ --jsx-pragma h --no-copy --verbose

# Watch mode (re-transpile on save)
yggdrasil src/ --out-dir dist/ --watch

# React 17 automatic runtime
yggdrasil src/ --out-dir dist/ --jsx-runtime automatic

# Explicit files
yggdrasil --out-dir dist/ src/Button.jsx src/Icon.jsx

# Parallel with 4 threads
yggdrasil src/ --out-dir dist/ --threads 4

# Multi-error recovery
yggdrasil --recover broken.jsx
```

---

## JSX Pragma Modes

| Flag | Pragma call | Fragment | Use case |
|------|-------------|----------|----------|
| `--pragma react` | `React.createElement` | `React.Fragment` | Classic React (default) |
| `--pragma h` | `h` | `Fragment` | Preact, hyperscript |
| `--pragma jsx` | `_jsx` | `_Fragment` | Custom alias |
| `--pragma auto` | `_jsx` | `_Fragment` | React 17+ with auto-import |

`--jsx-runtime automatic` is equivalent to `--pragma auto` and prepends:
```js
import { jsx as _jsx, jsxs as _jsxs, Fragment as _Fragment } from "react/jsx-runtime";
```

---

## Running Tests

```sh
# All unit/fixture tests (Stages 1 + 2)
make test

# Stage 3 batch/directory tests
powershell -File tests\runner\run_stage3_tests.ps1

# Filter fixture tests
powershell -File tests\runner\run_tests.ps1 -Filter "3*"
```

### Fixture conventions

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `*.jsx` | Input source |
| `*.expected.js` | Expected transpiled output |
| `*.expected_exit` | Expected exit code (error tests) |
| `*.flags` | Extra CLI flags for that fixture |

---

## Architecture

```
include/
  token.h        TokenKind enum + Token struct
  lexer.h        Self-managing mode-stack lexer (JS / JSXTag / JSXChildren)
  ast.h          Flat Node struct + NodeKind enum
  parser.h       Recursive-descent parser with JSX grammar + error recovery
  codegen.h      CodeGen + CodeGenOptions (pragma, dev, indent)
  diagnostics.h  LexError / ParseError / CodeGenError + ErrorCollector
  batch.h        BatchEngine: recursive scan, parallel transpile/copy
  threadpool.h   Fixed-size thread pool (std::thread + condition_variable)
  watcher.h      File watcher (ReadDirectoryChangesW / polling)

src/
  lexer.cpp      Context-aware tokeniser — self-pushes/pops JSX modes
  parser.cpp     Full JS + JSX parser; optional multi-error recovery
  codegen.cpp    AST walker; lowers JSX to configurable pragma calls
  diagnostics.cpp  ErrorCollector::dump()
  batch.cpp      BatchEngine::run() + processFile()
  threadpool.cpp ThreadPool worker loop
  watcher.cpp    watchWindows() + watchPolling()
  main.cpp       CLI: single-file, batch, directory, watch modes

tests/
  fixtures/      48 unit fixtures (*.jsx + *.expected.js|*.expected_exit|*.flags)
  stage3/
    src/         Sample directory tree (components/, pages/, utils/)
    expected/    Pre-computed expected outputs for batch comparison
  runner/
    run_tests.ps1        Stage 1+2 fixture runner
    run_stage3_tests.ps1 Stage 3 batch/directory tests (17 scenarios)
```

### Key design decisions

**Self-managing lexer mode stack** — the lexer tracks JSX context internally (`JSXTag` / `JSXChildren` / `JS`), pushed/popped as it emits specific tokens. The parser never needs to call `pushMode`/`popMode`.

**Flat AST node** — all node kinds share one `Node` struct. Avoids virtual dispatch and header pollution.

**Parallel batch with error isolation** — each file runs in its own thread-pool task. A `std::mutex` guards the shared `BatchResult`. One failing file increments `failed` but other tasks continue uninterrupted.

**Watch mode strategy** — on Windows, `ReadDirectoryChangesW` with `FILE_FLAG_OVERLAPPED` gives sub-second latency with zero CPU spin. On other platforms, a polling loop with configurable interval is used. The watcher calls `BatchEngine::processFile()` directly — same code path as batch.

**Brace-depth tracking** — to correctly pop back from `{expr}` inside JSX, the lexer maintains a stack of brace depths recorded at each JS-inside-JSX entry point.

---

## Supported JSX Grammar

```
JSXElement      ::= '<' JSXTagName JSXAttribute* ('/>' | '>' JSXChild* JSXClosingTag)
JSXFragment     ::= '<>' JSXChild* '</>'
JSXTagName      ::= Identifier ('.' Identifier)* | Identifier ':' Identifier
JSXChild        ::= JSXText | JSXExprContainer | JSXElement | JSXFragment
JSXExprContainer::= '{' ('...' Expr | Expr | /* comment */) '}'
JSXAttribute    ::= JSXSpread | JSXAttrName ('=' JSXAttrValue)?
JSXSpread       ::= '{' '...' Expr '}'
JSXAttrName     ::= Identifier ('-' Identifier)*    (data-*, aria-*)
JSXAttrValue    ::= JSXString | JSXExprContainer
```

---

## What Yggdrasil Does NOT Do

- Parse or resolve `import`/`export` module paths
- Touch `node_modules`
- Build dependency graphs or bundle files
- Tree-shake, concatenate, or minify
- Handle CSS, assets, or non-JS/JSX files
- Emit source maps

---

| Stage 3 batch tests T1–T10 | 17 | Directory batch, passthrough, --no-copy, --pragma, --jsx-runtime, --verbose, --threads, explicit files, error isolation, missing src |

# Yggdrasil

A JSX-to-JavaScript transpiler written in C++17.  
Yggdrasil parses JSX source files and emits standard JavaScript — the same transformation Babel performs with `@babel/plugin-transform-react-jsx`.

It operates in three modes:
- **Single-file** — transpile one `.jsx` to stdout or a file
- **Batch** — transpile an entire source directory tree in parallel
- **Watch** — monitor the source tree and re-transpile on every save

---

## Features

### Stage 1 — Core JSX transpilation
- Self-closing, opening/closing, and nested JSX elements
- Component tags (uppercase), member-expression tags (`Foo.Bar`)
- String, expression, boolean, and spread (`{...obj}`) attributes
- JSX fragments (`<>...</>`)
- Text children, expression children (`{expr}`), and mapped children
- Full JavaScript: `const`/`let`/`var`, arrow functions, destructuring params, `async`/`await`, template literals, spread, ternary, logical operators, `import`/`export` (default, named, namespace, side-effect)
- Diagnostic output with `file:line:col` format

### Stage 2 — Solid Tool extensions
- **Configurable JSX pragma** via `--pragma`: `react` (default), `h`, `jsx`, `auto`
- **React 17 auto-import** (`--pragma auto` / `--jsx-runtime automatic`): prepends `import { jsx as _jsx, ... } from 'react/jsx-runtime'`
- **Dev mode** (`--dev`): injects `__source` and `__self` props
- **Namespace tags**: `<svg:circle />` → `"svg:circle"`
- **JSX comments**: `{/* ... */}` silently dropped
- **Spread children**: `{...items}` in JSX children
- **Hyphenated attributes**: `data-*`, `aria-*` → quoted keys (`"data-x": val`)
- **Multi-error recovery** (`--recover`): collects up to 20 errors, reports all
- **Per-fixture CLI flags**: `.flags` files for the test runner

### Stage 3 — Directory CLI & Batch Transpiler
- **Recursive directory scan** — mirrors `src/` tree into `dist/` with `std::filesystem`
- **Parallel transpilation** — custom thread pool (`std::thread` + mutex/condition_variable), defaults to `hardware_concurrency` threads
- **Passthrough copy** — plain `.js` files copied untouched; skipped with `--no-copy`
- **Watch mode** — re-transpiles changed files on save:
  - Windows: `ReadDirectoryChangesW` (low-latency, native)
  - Other platforms: configurable polling loop (default 500 ms)
- **Error isolation** — one bad file never kills the batch; errors aggregated and reported at the end
- **`--jsx-pragma` / `--jsx-runtime` aliases** for toolchain compatibility
- **`--verbose`** — prints `src/Foo.jsx  ->  dist/Foo.js` for every file
- **`--threads N`** — explicit worker count

---

## Building

### Requirements
- `clang++` with C++17 support
- `make` (GNU Make)
- PowerShell 5.1+ (Windows) or bash (Unix/macOS)

### Build

```sh
# Default
make

# Optimised release
make release

# Debug with ASan/UBSan
make debug

# Clean
make clean
```

Binary: `bin/yggdrasil` (Unix) or `bin\yggdrasil.exe` (Windows).

---

## Usage

```
Usage:
  yggdrasil [options] <input.jsx>                   single file
  yggdrasil [options] --out-dir <dir> <files...>    explicit batch
  yggdrasil [options] <srcDir> --out-dir <dir>      directory batch

Options:
  -o <file>                  Output file (single-file mode)
  --out-dir <dir>            Output directory
  --pragma <name>            JSX pragma: react (default), h, jsx, auto
  --jsx-pragma <name>        Alias for --pragma
  --jsx-runtime <mode>       classic (default) | automatic
  --dev                      Emit __source/__self dev props
  --no-copy                  Skip .js passthrough in batch mode
  --verbose                  Print each file processed
  --watch                    Re-transpile on file changes
  --threads <n>              Worker thread count
  --recover                  Collect multiple errors before stopping
  -h, --help                 Show this help
```

### Examples

```sh
# Single file to stdout
yggdrasil App.jsx

# Single file to output
yggdrasil App.jsx -o App.js

# Directory batch
yggdrasil src/ --out-dir dist/

# Directory batch — Preact pragma, skip .js copy, verbose
yggdrasil src/ --out-dir dist/ --jsx-pragma h --no-copy --verbose

# Watch mode (re-transpile on save)
yggdrasil src/ --out-dir dist/ --watch

# React 17 automatic runtime
yggdrasil src/ --out-dir dist/ --jsx-runtime automatic

# Explicit files
yggdrasil --out-dir dist/ src/Button.jsx src/Icon.jsx

# Parallel with 4 threads
yggdrasil src/ --out-dir dist/ --threads 4

# Multi-error recovery
yggdrasil --recover broken.jsx
```

---

## JSX Pragma Modes

| Flag | Pragma call | Fragment | Use case |
|------|-------------|----------|----------|
| `--pragma react` | `React.createElement` | `React.Fragment` | Classic React (default) |
| `--pragma h` | `h` | `Fragment` | Preact, hyperscript |
| `--pragma jsx` | `_jsx` | `_Fragment` | Custom alias |
| `--pragma auto` | `_jsx` | `_Fragment` | React 17+ with auto-import |

`--jsx-runtime automatic` is equivalent to `--pragma auto` and prepends:
```js
import { jsx as _jsx, jsxs as _jsxs, Fragment as _Fragment } from "react/jsx-runtime";
```

---

## Running Tests

```sh
# All unit/fixture tests (Stages 1 + 2)
make test

# Stage 3 batch/directory tests
powershell -File tests\runner\run_stage3_tests.ps1

# Filter fixture tests
powershell -File tests\runner\run_tests.ps1 -Filter "3*"
```

### Fixture conventions

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `*.jsx` | Input source |
| `*.expected.js` | Expected transpiled output |
| `*.expected_exit` | Expected exit code (error tests) |
| `*.flags` | Extra CLI flags for that fixture |

---

## Architecture

```
include/
  token.h        TokenKind enum + Token struct
  lexer.h        Self-managing mode-stack lexer (JS / JSXTag / JSXChildren)
  ast.h          Flat Node struct + NodeKind enum
  parser.h       Recursive-descent parser with JSX grammar + error recovery
  codegen.h      CodeGen + CodeGenOptions (pragma, dev, indent)
  diagnostics.h  LexError / ParseError / CodeGenError + ErrorCollector
  batch.h        BatchEngine: recursive scan, parallel transpile/copy
  threadpool.h   Fixed-size thread pool (std::thread + condition_variable)
  watcher.h      File watcher (ReadDirectoryChangesW / polling)

src/
  lexer.cpp      Context-aware tokeniser — self-pushes/pops JSX modes
  parser.cpp     Full JS + JSX parser; optional multi-error recovery
  codegen.cpp    AST walker; lowers JSX to configurable pragma calls
  diagnostics.cpp  ErrorCollector::dump()
  batch.cpp      BatchEngine::run() + processFile()
  threadpool.cpp ThreadPool worker loop
  watcher.cpp    watchWindows() + watchPolling()
  main.cpp       CLI: single-file, batch, directory, watch modes

tests/
  fixtures/      48 unit fixtures (*.jsx + *.expected.js|*.expected_exit|*.flags)
  stage3/
    src/         Sample directory tree (components/, pages/, utils/)
    expected/    Pre-computed expected outputs for batch comparison
  runner/
    run_tests.ps1        Stage 1+2 fixture runner
    run_stage3_tests.ps1 Stage 3 batch/directory tests (17 scenarios)
```

### Key design decisions

**Self-managing lexer mode stack** — the lexer tracks JSX context internally (`JSXTag` / `JSXChildren` / `JS`), pushed/popped as it emits specific tokens. The parser never needs to call `pushMode`/`popMode`.

**Flat AST node** — all node kinds share one `Node` struct. Avoids virtual dispatch and header pollution.

**Parallel batch with error isolation** — each file runs in its own thread-pool task. A `std::mutex` guards the shared `BatchResult`. One failing file increments `failed` but other tasks continue uninterrupted.

**Watch mode strategy** — on Windows, `ReadDirectoryChangesW` with `FILE_FLAG_OVERLAPPED` gives sub-second latency with zero CPU spin. On other platforms, a polling loop with configurable interval is used. The watcher calls `BatchEngine::processFile()` directly — same code path as batch.

**Brace-depth tracking** — to correctly pop back from `{expr}` inside JSX, the lexer maintains a stack of brace depths recorded at each JS-inside-JSX entry point.

---

## Supported JSX Grammar

```
JSXElement      ::= '<' JSXTagName JSXAttribute* ('/>' | '>' JSXChild* JSXClosingTag)
JSXFragment     ::= '<>' JSXChild* '</>'
JSXTagName      ::= Identifier ('.' Identifier)* | Identifier ':' Identifier
JSXChild        ::= JSXText | JSXExprContainer | JSXElement | JSXFragment
JSXExprContainer::= '{' ('...' Expr | Expr | /* comment */) '}'
JSXAttribute    ::= JSXSpread | JSXAttrName ('=' JSXAttrValue)?
JSXSpread       ::= '{' '...' Expr '}'
JSXAttrName     ::= Identifier ('-' Identifier)*    (data-*, aria-*)
JSXAttrValue    ::= JSXString | JSXExprContainer
```

---

## What Yggdrasil Does NOT Do

- Parse or resolve `import`/`export` module paths
- Touch `node_modules`
- Build dependency graphs or bundle files
- Tree-shake, concatenate, or minify
- Handle CSS, assets, or non-JS/JSX files
- Emit source maps

---

## Test Coverage Summary (65 total)

| Suite | Count | Coverage |
|-------|-------|----------|
| Stage 1 fixtures 01–30 | 30 | Self-closing, attrs, nesting, fragments, imports, arrows, destructuring, async, operators |
| Stage 2 fixtures 31–44 | 14 | Namespace tags, JSX comments, spread children, pragmas h/jsx/auto, aria/data attrs, whitespace, error recovery |
| Error fixtures err_01–04 | 4 | Mismatched tags, unclosed tag, bad attr value, unexpected token |
| Stage 3 batch tests T1–T10 | 17 | Directory batch, passthrough, --no-copy, --pragma, --jsx-runtime, --verbose, --threads, explicit files, error isolation, missing src |

---
